quarterly_data.quarter: Naver press release: NAVER Cloud Partners with Vietnam's Largest IT Company on (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner FPT: NAVER Cloud signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with FPT, Vietnam's leading IT company and an NVIDIA Cloud Partner, at NAVER 1784, agreeing to explore cooperation in areas such as the planning, development and operation of the AI factory business; the release says the two are joining forces to develop an AI factory business and expand GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) offerings across Asia-Pacific markets including Korea, Japan and Vietnam. The partnership combines both companies' GPU infrastructure, cloud technologies, business capabilities and customer networks to provide infrastructure, AI models and AI services to enterprises and AI service providers that need GPU computing for large-scale AI training and inference; the two will run a regular technical exchange program (NAVER Cloud headquarters and its Vietnam development center with FPT engineers) and work together at customer sites on GPU infrastructure optimization, AI inference performance and production environments for AI agents. NAVER Cloud CEO Kim Yu-won: 'we will go beyond Korea and Vietnam to address customers' diverse AI needs across APAC and build a partnership that delivers real business results.'
